'''FC Isloch Minsk Raion''' or '''Islach''' ({{langx|be|ФК Іслач}}; {{langx|ru|ФК Ислочь|link=no}}) is a Belarusian professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Minsk]], although it officially represents [[Minsk Raion]] and is named after the [[Islach River]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://fcisloch.by/klub/history/|title=History of FC Isloch|access-date=2017-03-15|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160712200446/http://fcisloch.by/klub/history/|archive-date=2016-07-12|url-status=dead}}</ref>"}}
